sloka: व्रीडिताम् दुह्ख सम्तप्ताम् परिम्लानाम् तपस्विनीम् ।ग्रहेण अन्गारकेण एव पीडिताम् इव रोहिणीम् ॥५-१५-२२॥
transliteration: vrīḍitām duhkha samtaptām parimlānām tapasvinīm ।graheṇa angārakeṇa eva pīḍitām iva rohiṇīm ॥5-15-22॥

translations.english: She was bashful, tormented with agony, dejected with a withered look. She appeared like the star Rohini oppressed by planet Mars.
